about_the_game:
Moonvile is a PvP game for up to 12 players, played between Wizards and Hunters.

The Hunters use the magic they carry within their minds to hunt down nearby Wizards, reclaim Moonvile, which was once taken from them, and take revenge on the Wizards.

Knowing the power of the Hunters, the Wizards gather items in the environment to open a dimensional portal, escape Moonvile safely, and one day return stronger.

WHAT DO THE WIZARDS DO?

Wizards collect magical books and potions scattered around the map.
Their main goal is to combine these potions, break the shields of the magical cauldrons, and escape from Moonvile.

At the start of each game, it can be configured how many potions are required to break the cauldron shields.

During this process, Wizards take magical books into their inventory to avoid being easy targets for the Hunters. When confronted by Hunters, they can read and use these books to protect themselves or rescue their friends.

WHAT DO THE HUNTERS DO?

The Hunters were long excluded and bullied by the Wizards because of their abilities. Their goal is to prevent all Wizards from escaping, bring them to the brink of death, and take their revenge.

At the beginning of the game, Hunters choose the spells they will use depending on the map and create their own set. They then try to stop all the Wizards and live peacefully in Moonvile once again. However, since they are outnumbered, this will not be easy.

About the Demo

  • The Moonvile Demo has been released to give players an early look at the game’s core PvP mechanics. This version is limited to a single map and a set number of rounds, allowing us to test stability, optimize resources, and gather valuable player feedback before the full release.

  • The demo also serves as a balance-testing phase. Based on community input, spells and abilities may be adjusted, added, or removed to improve gameplay.

Demo vs. Full Game

  • Maps: Demo includes 1 map; full release will feature 5 unique maps.

  • Content: Demo presents core Wizard vs Hunter gameplay; full game will expand with more spells, abilities, and progression features.

  • Audio & Visuals: Full version includes upgraded sound design, improved effects, and polished visuals.

  • Balancing: Demo is actively updated based on community feedback, leading into the final release.

  • Additional Features: The full release will also include extra systems and content not present in the demo, which are currently under development.

Your participation and feedback are vital to shaping Moonvile into the best experience possible.
